name: BBY Q — verifiable performance measurements
status: historical CI measurements, integration reproduction CI queued at first report
scope: XI/Ether symbolic and supervised languages, not open-ended general AI benchmark

representation_study.caveat: Normalized frame/entity/value representation does not preserve all original ASCII case/format. It is not lossless equivalence of arbitrary text.

benchmark_same_protocol.subject: BBY Q E032 versus SOVENGI default 35-model rotating catalog
caveats: Same virtual runner/CPU affinity but different algorithm tasks and response lengths
Process tree RSS sampled, may count shared pages multiple times
BBYQ fact ingestion timed separately while SOVENGI context preparation occurs during query
First-use lazy model loading and rotating ensemble changes cost
32 domain-focused questions and AI-only semantic review are not proof of model general capability

limitations: Neither benchmark measures physical quantum acceleration or causal computer speedups
Positive test counts are per bounded program contracts, not open-ended conversation score
Latency/RSS across E033 and E034 are DIFFERENT tasks and runner runs: never infer a speedup/slowdown
Existing E034 checkpoint preserved; compilation into a final Android APK requires separate migration
Integration branch CI result and main merge status must be checked remotely
